content: If your Z axis is not moving correctly during this step, power the printer off, turn the Z screws by hand and if they feel hard to turn try to loosen and retighten the trapezoidal nut on Z ball screws. Two of my Z motors were completely jammed after performing the steps to insert the spacers that come with the INDX kit. It was really scary to watch the bed suddenly tilt to one side during the first self test!
